header.name: Successful Social Entrepreneurship
header.description: The tech-age we are living in today, is also the age of the social entrepreneur. Technology has shrunk the globe and with it, shrunk costs, time and space requirements for any business. It has created a plethora of opportunities for young go-getters to get all the benefits of entrepreneurship with the added plus of satisfaction with the good you are doing. The trick however is to balance the social impact you want to create with the business's need for healthy returns and growth. Using a personalized, application oriented pedagogy, this course helps you understand social entrepreneurship, the driving forces for the entrepreneur and entrepreneurship, critical success factors, models to plan for success as a social entrepreneur, useful resources, frequently experienced problems and navigating your way through them, measuring impact and planning your growth strategy.
prerequisites_desirable: Students who have a Social Enterprise idea/product they want to explore will benefit more from the course. Students who do not yet have a product, will work on an SE business idea provided by the course instructor.
